item.title: Jim Mullen on leading TCA through trucking's 'law and order' era and a freight market turn
item.description: Jim Mullen becomes president of the Truckload Carriers Association in April. How will he use his experience to lead the truckload community?

item.title: FMCSA chief vows to ‘clean up the mess’ in modern trucking
item.description: Derek Barrs, the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration leader, told truckload executives that the agency’s era of passive oversight is over as the former law enforcement officer takes on trucking’s 'bad actors, so the good can prevail.’

item.title: Mack Trucks unveils redesigned Granite and all-new Keystone at Las Vegas Speedway
item.description: The new Mack Granite features a powerful MP13 engine, wider cab, and intelligent architecture for easier upfitting, while the versatile Mack Keystone offers high ground clearance and off-road capabilities, both emphasizing driver comfort and safety.

item.title: Diesel and gasoline costs climb as summer-blend production begins
item.description: Diesel prices rise across the U.S., with the West Coast topping $4.53 per gallon this week.

item.title: Roeth: Why trucking needs to stop 'greenhushing' its sustainability wins
item.description: While regulations shift, many fleets continue cutting fuel use and emissions—but aren’t talking about it.

item.title: Benchmarking fleet maintenance: Insights from Fleetio’s industry data
item.description: Fleetio’s data reveals maintenance cost disparities based on vehicle age and management practices, emphasizing the importance of planned maintenance and timely vehicle replacement.

item.title: Kenworth unveils the C580: The brand's next-gen extreme-duty truck
item.description: Designed to handle extreme conditions from the Arctic to the Amazon, the Kenworth C580 combines durability with modern innovations like ADAS, digital displays, and high-performance cooling.

item.title: Flatbed rates hit highest level since April 2025 as spot volumes increase
item.description: Spot rates for van, reefer, and flatbed show strong year-over-year gains, with volume increases signaling shifting freight demand.

item.title: Fleet intelligence today drives success in autonomous trucking tomorrow
item.description: Autonomous trucking depends on fleet-wide intelligence today to improve safety, uptime, and operational efficiency for tomorrow’s automation.

item.title: For-hire market is finally starting to turn—but freight is still weak
item.description: For-hire pricing might finally get a boost this year, driven not by booming freight demand but by continued capacity shrinkage.
